description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Decorator_Cleanup that extends a base decorator class to add cleanup functionality for a cache within the HTMLPurifier library. The class provides methods to add, set, replace, and get cache items, invoking cleanup whenever these operations fail.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Decorator_Cleanup
classes.description: A decorator class that adds cache cleanup behavior to the underlying cache operations, invoked on cache miss or failure.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the cleanup decorator.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a definition to the cache; if failed, triggers cleanup.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a definition in the cache; if failed, triggers cleanup.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces a definition in the cache; if failed, triggers cleanup.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache item; if not found, triggers cleanup.
